Description
We are looking for a passionate Full-stack Software Engineer (ReactJS/ NextJS + .NET) to embark on the journey with us and take part in the development team.
You are responsible to gathering requirements, defining functionalities, writing code and testing it properly before deploying. As a result, together with our development team, we build high-quality and fully performing software that complies with coding standards and technical design.
yeu_cau:
Key job responsibilities
Analyze requirements, design, programming and perform testing based on design.
Resolve technical issues through debugging, research and investigation.
Communicate, collaborate and team work effectively across distributed features
Involve in troubleshooting blocking issues
Owning and working end-to-end on applications
Participate in taking and clarifying requirements with clients
Required qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
You are experienced with these 2 tech stacks: ReactJS/NextJS for front-end and .NET for back-end, or another back-end tech stack
At least 3 years of experience in software development
Experience with source-code management systems like Git
Familiarity with OOP design principles
Experience with third-party libraries and APIs
Superior analytical skills with a good problem-solving attitude
Experience working with JIRA & Confluence
Experience working Scrum/Agile framework and principles
Ability to write clean, maintainable code, plus good troubleshooting skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
